## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2024-06-24: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the S-1
- 2024-07-19: IPO closed; TRA executed
- 2024-07-23: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the closing 8-K

## Explanation

TWFG, Inc. executed this TRA on July 19, 2024 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future purchases, redemptions, or exchanges of TWFG Holding Company, LLC Units, plus imputed-interest deductions on the TRA payments themselves. The three named LLC-member beneficiaries are Bunch Family Holdings, LLC, RenaissanceRe Ventures U.S. LLC, and GHC Woodlands Holdings, LLC. No LLC Unit exchanges have occurred since the IPO and the underlying deferred tax asset carries a full valuation allowance, so the company has recognized no TRA liability on either the FY2024 or FY2025 balance sheet. No amendment, restatement, or termination instrument has been filed; the TRA remains in force as of Q1 2026. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
